gaps.explanation: Statement p6 (Exhibit H, Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds) prints 'Transfers to other funds' (50,000) in the Electric Fund 2025 column (Water and Sewer 0; Totals (50,000) on p7) = JSON business_type.transfers_net -50,000. The business-type schedule already in detail[] is Schedule 3 (trimmed p13, Combined Statement of Cash Receipts and Cash Disbursements - Compared to Budget - Budgetary Cash Basis), which prints one Proprietary disbursements line 448,419 that already includes this 50,000 transfer (448,419 = operating disbursements 433,122 - depreciation 43,678 + capital asset purchases 8,975 + transfers 50,000; pass 1). Adding a separate Transfers Out -50,000 line would count the 50,000 twice in detail[], and the printed 448,419 cannot be split. The schedule simply prints transfers inside disbursements on the budgetary basis. No fix.
